item.text: The marker scan currently advances inside a `for` loop, then checks the new position in the same iteration. That can skip following code or reach the line end incorrectly. It also scans for triple quotes while an ordinary string is open. I’ll make marker handling advance the main scan once, and only open a triple quote outside an ordinary string.
